campaign_duration.meaning: creator-supplied campaign duration passed to campaign creation

EPOCH_DURATION.meaning: discrete protocol epoch duration (1 hour) used for reward calculation and distribution

partial_epoch_campaign.meaning: resulting campaign covers one full epoch plus a partial half-epoch

assumptions: The off-chain indexing engine strictly expects epoch-aligned campaigns.
Campaign duration and EPOCH_DURATION are compared in the same unit (seconds).
The supplied 5400-second duration is an example; the duration value is modeled symbolically.
No other validation rejects a non-multiple duration before the campaign is recorded.

unresolved.description: The report does not specify whether the 5400-second duration is supplied through _createCampaign or overrideCampaign, so the exact enforcement checkpoint for the multiple-of-EPOCH_DURATION requirement is ambiguous.

limitations: Secondary consequence i_offchain_reject_or_drop (campaign rejection locking user funds or dropping the final partial epoch) is conditional and deferred, not part of the core V.
Only i_partial_epoch_campaign is modeled as the direct impact of the core V.
The root cause rc_missing_multiple_check (missing enforcement in DistributionCreator) is not selected as a precondition.
The security intent si_enforce_duration_multiple describes desired enforcement behavior and is not part of actual P.
